prompted_for: Explanatory text without a wall of text (original of concept-o-prose; became Prose: pulled-out lead, narrow column, margin notes)
composition: large framed sheet divided by a coarse module grid over a fine graph-paper grid
logo and section label in the top row
small caps kicker above a big two-line headline crossing grid columns
two short text blocks offset into different columns and rows (staggered)
annotations along the right edge connected by leader lines
mobile column stacks kicker, headline, numbered dividers and paragraphs
layout_devices: leader lines with dot ends linking text blocks to bracketed numbered margin notes '[01]'
dimension lines over desktop and mobile frames with px widths
vertical dimension bar at the left edge
tiny row-height labels in grid cells
numbered horizontal rules on mobile separating paragraphs
palette: steel-blue module lines and annotation text
warm limestone off-white headline and body text
typography: condensed bold caps headline, tall and tight
regular condensed sans body at large size
monospace bracketed annotation labels and section index
line_and_texture: fine graph-paper grid at low contrast
hairline leader lines with small dot terminals and angled kinks
motion_implied: leader lines draw from text to margin note
paragraphs fade in cell by cell
grid fades up before the type
t2i_keywords: coarse module grid lines in steel blue
short paragraphs offset in staggered grid cells
desktop and mobile frames side by side
row height annotations in grid cells
t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a narrow mobile view beside it, no device frame, no people. Deep navy blueprint background with a faint graph-paper grid and coarser steel-blue module lines, dimension lines above each frame. Small logo and monospace section index top-left. A small caps kicker over a large condensed off-white headline spanning several grid columns. Two short paragraphs of <CONTENT> sit in different staggered grid cells, each linked by a thin leader line with dot ends to a bracketed numbered note at the margin. Mobile stacks headline and paragraphs separated by numbered hairline rules.
signature_idea: Body text laid out on a drafting grid like annotations on a drawing, each paragraph tied to a numbered margin note by a leader line.
strengths: breaks prose into short staggered blocks, avoiding a wall of text
margin notes give a scan path for engineers
blueprint grid ties text sections to the drawing language of the site
weaknesses: graph-paper grid behind body text lowers legibility
heavy condensed caps headline and hype copy are off-voice
leader lines connect text to labels that repeat it, so decorative
blueprint cliché if used on every prose section
brand_fit_why: Navy and steel-blue drafting grid, mono annotations and square corners fit, but busy grid texture, bold condensed caps and crowded type ignore the light headlines and calm space.
